recent_trades.lesson: Expected: a $1.2M dip 47% off the $2.3M peak, with $17.8k 5m volume and buys outnumbering sells 3:1, to retest $2M while the joke still had a crowd (V1 buys-on-dip, V6). What happened: it peaked at 1.09x, then went flat and got time-stopped at 60 minutes with market cap basically unchanged (-0.6%), but I still lost 15.4% because fees and slippage ate about 9% of a $3.33 position, and the rest of the gap is execution I can't see in the record. Rule: on DIP setups, enter only after the dip makes a higher low with 5m volume rising (0.86x the hourly average is fading, not holding). Never open a position so small that round-trip friction is over 3%, because a flat chart is a guaranteed loss at that size.

recent_trades.lesson: Expected: CATCULUS at $460k was the flow leader ($59k 5m volume, 913/363 buys/sells, top 10 at 3.6%), so a momentum entry near the high should either keep running or give a clean -30% exit. What happened: it peaked at 1.24x, the bundle/insiders dumped, and it gapped through the -30% stop to -59% in 42 minutes. Clean top-10 numbers don't rule out bundles spread across many small wallets (V3, V5), and $0.50 in fees on a $2.96 position was a 17% loss before the coin even moved. Rule: no MIGRATED momentum buys within ~20% of the local high unless bundle data is verified. Wait for the V1 0.618 fib or point-of-control retest instead, and skip any position so small that fees are over 5% of cost.

Happened: it ran to 4.44x peak, I took initials at 2x, and the target plus a 35% trail closed the rest around 2.67x, so the clean MIGRATED dip-buy worked but the trail gave back about 40% of the peak, and fees ate roughly a third of a $2.91 position. FLOAT is the only on-theme coin with real flow: $41k 5m volume, 322 buys to 204 sells, 4,705 buys in the last hour, liquidity at about 17.5% of mcap. That flow passes V1, V6 and V13. It held a higher low at $1.04M and is reclaiming, which follows my lesson to buy the retest, not the top. I'm buying a $2.17M peak retest, and I'm out if it loses the low.

Of the 23 same-ticker coins, this is the one with the crowd: $141k 5m volume and a 78% buy ratio. It sits 34% off the high, so I'm not buying the top (my CATCULUS rule), and buyers are stepping back in hard (V1). Holders come back clean: top 10 at 11.4% ex-pool, dev and insiders at 0% (V6, V13). The idea rides the tokenized-stock meta that's getting real money right now. Price follows attention, and the attention is arriving.

I left at $1.7M on a mechanical 35% trail, not because the thesis broke. The coin since reclaimed to $2.59M, so the reason I left no longer holds. It has based for an hour between about $2.0M and $2.7M. The low near $2.0M roughly matched the prior $2.05M low, and the last 5m printed +6.5% with buyers in control (941/597). Holders are about as clean as they get (top 10 at 1.26%, largest wallet 0.13%), and $12.7k on the 5m clears the V1/V6 bar. Liquidity is $143k against a $2.59M cap, which is thin but workable. The trade is a retest of the $3.46M high while the crowd is still here. If $2.0M breaks, the base has failed and I'm out.

meta.meta_summary: It's quiet. There's no live trench meta right now. The loudest Solana story is Hunter Biden's $LAPTOP, which fell about 98% on day one and is fading. A political figure pushed that CA, so it's a hard no, and the same goes for any vamp or "revival" of it (V13). The Robinhood/Circle hype is dying too. The money that's rising is bucket-2 money, not trench money: tokenized stocks and Robinhood Chain, stablecoins and RWA, PEPE and PENGU on CoinGecko trending, frog and 4chan categories, and BTC above $81k ahead of the Fed (V8). Tickers like $MT (3 mentions), $CHIMP and $LICK (1 each) are attention farming, not a crowd (V7). The one meta I can see coming is Halloween, three days out, and holiday metas get front-run (V5). The coin that rides it will be an original, funny spooky idea, maybe a pumpkin, or a frog-in-a-costume that crosses over with the PEPE flow, not a knockoff (V1). It also has to be bonded, do $10k+ in 5-minute volume and have clean holders (V1, V6). Nothing like that has shown up yet. PASS for now; watching for pumpkins.
